implementation: The default-off whole-provider QRT_QWEN36_Q8192_CONV_CONSUMER_AUDIT option wraps the original cold q8192 QKV correction callback. It copies the untouched producer, computes certificates, calls every original correction, runs the original convolution into private scratch and compares all intervals/outputs with a bounded completed GPU reduction. It does not suppress candidates. Prefix suffixes and intermediate checkpoint stores are outside this observation route. Numerical certificate failures remain diagnostics so original inference can complete independently; HIP, capacity and redzone failures abort the observer.
correctness_scope: The actual runtime owner and all16 GPU metrics match the separate complete67108864-cell host audit. All original GB10 projection references and7169 convolution rows remain exact. A null output is rejected without a callback; an injected callback failure after queued preparation is returned after cleanup and leaves the complete projection unchanged. All private redzones, source operands and held-out references pass. Source and artifact hashes bind both the harness and final whole DLL. This component does not load the model or produce tokens.
timing_scope: The actual observer owner includes its805310592-byte temporary allocation, producer copy, certificate, unchanged original correction callback, duplicate original convolution, observation reduction, completed readbacks and freeing. It excludes the already completed upstream producer and L2 bounds. This instrumentation is not a speedup or comparable product timing.
